CASE 01 · MODERNIZATION

Modernizing a large Android application

Reducing legacy complexity while improving dependency management and persistence patterns.

KotlinHiltDataStoreMVVM
CASE 02 · RELIABILITY

Diagnosing production stability issues

Investigating defects across Android runtime behavior, API data and database operations.

  • Diagnosed a static-reference memory leak using WeakReference.
  • Investigated production crashes with Crashlytics and LeakCanary.
  • Resolved SQL/data-integrity issues including COALESCE/LEFT JOIN defects.
CrashlyticsLeakCanarySQLDebugging
CASE 03 · BACKEND

  • Built and maintained Node.js/Express services and parameterized MySQL queries.
RetrofitNode.jsMySQL
